items.title: Long-term student memory: structured evidence-backed academic profile (workflow §28)
items.notes: Migration 0020 (student_memories + student_memory_evidence; strict own-row RLS on both — a user touches ONLY their own rows, the owner has no code path to any member's memories; evidence cascades on forget; structured relational data, deliberately NO vector/embedding store). src/lib/memory/engine.ts (pure): 13 categories; evidence-backed hypotheses, never asserted facts — AI-inferred memories start 'monitoring' until weighted confidence clears 0.5; confidence recomputed from the FULL evidence history with recency weighting (120-day half-life), diminishing returns, symmetric support/contradiction, floor 0.05 cap 0.95; improvement trend from the evidence sequence (3 clean machine-verified solutions → 'improving'); lifecycle create/update/confirm/contradict/improve/archive/disable/forget/restore with student-controlled transitions (forgotten stays forgotten). src/lib/memory/store.ts: server-side store, NO service-role client, user_id scoping on every operation. AI integration: selectRelevantMemories injects ONLY context-relevant memories (subject-tag match, relevance-ranked, hard cap 8, non-retrievable statuses excluded) into the solve prompt with a NEVER-assert-as-diagnosis instruction; decisions persisted per response; used memories record last_used_at; evidence loop — observed mistakes become incorrect_problem evidence, machine-verified clean answers become correct_solution CONTRADICTING evidence on matching weaknesses. UI /memories (MemoryManager): search/filter by category+status, confidence bar, first/last observed, trend, origin badges (student-stated fact vs AI-inferred), evidence inspector, edit, disable, re-enable, archive, permanent forget with confirm, manual add. API /api/memory + /api/memory/[id]: requireUser + explicit scoping + RLS defense in depth. Live RLS regression matrix extended to TEN private categories (owner NO ACCESS to student memories); suite §28 machine-enforces schema, isolation, retrieval, evidence, and UI (1051/1051, tsc + build green).
